item.title: Minister provides update on new patient record system
item.description: A MAJOR project to introduce a new Electronic Patient Records system is set to conclude this year, the Health Minister has confirmed. item.title: Government discriminated against two disabled children, rules tribunal
item.description: THE government discriminated against two disabled children after officials refused a request to allow their childminder to continue caring for one of them once a week, a tribunal has found. item.title: “This was not an easy decision” – SGB Hire Channel Islands to close
item.description: SGB Hire Channel Islands – which has been in business for over five decades – is shutting its doors, it has been announced. Parent company BrandSafway said it would be supporting staff with “appropriate assistance” in the wake of the decision, which was made following “careful consideration and consultation with relevant stakeholders”. item.title: If Royal Assent can be stalled indefinitely on assisted dying, what prevents similar hesitation over future Island legislation?
item.description: By Carl Parslow WHEN the States Assembly voted on 26 February to approve the Island’s Assisted Dying Law, the moment was described as “historic”.
